newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Eastman Kodak to invest 100 mln punts in Limerick.
newsitem.headline: Eastman Kodak to invest 100 mln punts in Limerick.

text.p: Eastman Kodak, a manufacturer of photographic film, paper and related products, will create 400 new jobs over four years in a 100 million punt investment in Limerick, south-west Ireland, the Irish government said.

Ireland's Minister for Enterprise and Employment, Richard Bruton, said on Wednesday that the company had agreed a proposal with Irish state development authority, IDA, to manufacture film cassettes for a new Advanced Photo System (APS).
Bruton said the recruitment of the first 100 people at its proposed Limerick site is scheduled to commence in the middle of 1997.

Earlier this year, Eastman Kodak established a facility in Youghal, County Cork, in southern Ireland, to manufacture CD-Writable (CD-W) media and create almost 250 new jobs. --Dublin Newsroom, 353-1-660-3377
